_comment: T04 fixtures corpus (docs/build-orchestration-plan.md 'T04 Fixtures corpus'; docs/design-audit.md §4.4). Pure transcription of exact numbers/literals from the research repo's docs/reports/ (https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research). Nothing here is computed, rounded, converted, or reconciled between disagreeing reports. 'tag' matches the source report's own confirmed/derived/designed reading, not this task's judgment of the evidence. See each entry's 'source' (a report filename, checked against tests/fixtures/known-reports.json) and optional 'note' (a short quote or the exact context needed to check the reading without reopening the report).

TAFSupply_ChangeBuyAmount; confirms the ~98-100-troops-per-ton candidate from galatia-elimination-and-city-resupply-confirmed.md exactly against all four percentage readings on record (204/998=20%, 344/998=34%, 184/282=65%, 482/481=100% for the Roman 13-unit army).

Review round 3 (R1's resolution): TAFSupply_ChangeSupply (own-city, free) and TAFSupply_ChangeBuyAmount (foreign, paid) both cap an army's dialog transfer at troops div 100 + 1 -- an IDIV by 100 followed by an unconditional INC, no FPU instruction, no Round/Trunc -- on both paths alike. Confirmed against the Roman 13-unit roster's 48,173-troop army going from 403 to 482 tons at Rome (supplyTransfer.* above): 48173 div 100 = 481, one short of the observed, legal 482.

The fleet branch of both TAFSupply_ChangeSupply and TAFSupply_ChangeBuyAmount is MOV/SHL/SUB with no INC -- the same ships*8 formula as supply.capacityFormula.fleet, applied on both the free (own-city) and paid (foreign) dialog paths, with no dialog bonus the way the army side gets one. One fleet (owner 3, 70 ships) is held at exactly 70*8=560 tons in 26 saves.
